reading.title: What to know about this weekend's IndyCar race on the National Mall
reading.summary: Why is the car race in this part of D.C.? Will it be streaming? Who's paying for it? Here's what to know before the Freedom 250 Grand Prix hits the National Mall this weekend.

news.title: Wars are happening across the world. Many of them are connected
news.summary: All Thing Considered host Mary Louise Kelly speaks with NPR correspondents Tom Bowman and Emily Feng about the ways in which the U.S. war with Iran is connected to other conflicts across the globe.
